verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Shortcut has GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket integrations that update Shortcut as you work, and agents can be 'synced to GitHub'. Nothing documents syncing Shortcut stories two ways with a repository's issue tracker (e.g., GitHub Issues). Repo-activity updates and a general API are adjacent features or building blocks, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can keep tasks bi-directionally synced with my code repository's issue tracker instead of duplicating data
